category: AI sales roleplay and practice platforms

icp.description: B2B SaaS company, 150 sellers across SDRs and AEs, hiring 15-20 new reps per quarter.
jobs_to_be_done: get new reps to full productivity quickly and predictably
certify rep readiness before they get in front of real buyers
scale coaching and practice without eating manager time
priorities: cut ramp time: it has slipped and the CRO is watching
prove enablement's impact on revenue with hard numbers
roll out fast without a heavy program build

scenarios.situation: Our new-hire ramp is slipping badly. Classes that used to reach quota in four months are now taking six or more. Onboarding content looks fine on paper: reps pass certification, then freeze on real calls. Managers have no time to run practice, and my coaching program is basically shadowing plus a call library nobody watches.

My CRO just asked me why our reps' first live calls are effectively their first real practice. We hire 15 to 20 reps a quarter and I have no scalable way for them to rehearse discovery and objection handling before they burn real pipeline. Role-play with managers basically never happens: no time, and everyone hates doing it.
